items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1958-11-14
items.q: Yeah, Dan may know the whole family. Well I knew some of the family but because Dan was really not from Manneville, Dan was from Slider.

ctx.x: Yeah, probably some of the relatives are still over there.
Yeah, Dan may know the whole family. Well I knew some of the family but because Dan was really not from Manneville, Dan was from Slider.
Are there any musicians left in Mandeville that you know of? I tell you, I don't really know who's left over there.
